name: print-social-mirror-in-wheat-field-cover-with-split-headline
title: Person holding a round mirror in a wheat field, headline split around it under a big sky
whatItIs: A vertical photo of a green field and cloudy blue sky where a person hides behind a circular mirror reflecting the field. White geometric caps 'М'ЯКИЙ' and 'ПІДХІД' sit on either side of the mirror with small captions above and two asterisk-bulleted notes at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Reflective and gentle; the mirror shows the landscape instead of a face.
techniques: Split a headline around the central object.
Use a surreal prop (mirror) with nature.
Leave big sky as breathing space.
Put small notes in the bottom corners.

vocabulary.definition: A headline divided around an object.
An object used to create a dreamlike image.
Small bulleted text in the lower corners.
